properties.name: 18-AP-1862
properties.notes: Application for approval of reserved matters (access, appearance, landscaping, layout and scale) for Plot H11a within Elephant Park (previously referred to as the Heygate Masterplan), submitted pursuant to the Outline Planning Permission ref: 12/AP/1092. The proposals comprise the construction of three buildings ranging between 10 and 19 storeys in height (maximum height 67.8m AOD) comprising 222 residential units, 1,321.55 sqm (GEA) flexible retail, office, community and leisure (A1-A5/B1/D1/D2) uses, wheelchair accessible parking, cycle storage, servicing, plant areas, landscaping, new public realm, and other associated works.
properties.site-address: Plot H11A Within Land Bound By New Kent Road To The North Rodney Place To The East Plot H11B And Elephant Park To The South And Plot H5 To The West
